settings.description_override: Canvas gives the Boat Tote its relaxed character, framed by contrasting handles and a belted front. The textured body and visible stitching keep the construction part of the design, with a broad carryall shape that feels easy to reach for. Its appeal is in that meeting of practical form and considered detail: a familiar silhouette with enough personality to make the everyday feel a little more your own.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: Canvas carryall with contrast handles, trim and a belted front. Construction varies by listing and colorway; refer to the selected product’s photographs.

settings.heading: Materials and Care
settings.content: Canvas body with contrasting trim. Spot-clean gently with a barely damp cloth and air-dry fully. Avoid soaking, direct heat and prolonged sunlight.
